verse.en: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
verse.zh: 太初有道，道与神同在，道就是神。

verse.en: For God so loved the world that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him shall not perish but have eternal life.
verse.zh: 神爱世人，甚至将他的独生子赐给他们，叫一切信他的，不至灭亡，反得永生。

verse.en: The Lord is my shepherd, I lack nothing.
verse.zh: 耶和华是我的牧者，我必不至缺乏。

verse.en: I can do all this through him who gives me strength.
verse.zh: 我靠着那加给我力量的，凡事都能做。

verse.en: Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding.
verse.zh: 你要专心仰赖耶和华，不可倚靠自己的聪明。

verse.en: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, forbearance, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness and self-control.
verse.zh: 圣灵所结的果子，就是仁爱、喜乐、和平、忍耐、恩慈、良善、信实、温柔、节制。

verse.en: Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged, for the Lord your God will be with you wherever you go.
verse.zh: 你当刚强壮胆！不要惧怕，也不要惊惶，因为你无论往哪里去，耶和华你的神必与你同在。

verse.en: And we know that in all things God works for the good of those who love him, who have been called according to his purpose.
verse.zh: 我们晓得万事都互相效力，叫爱神的人得益处，就是按他旨意被召的人。

verse.en: Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.
verse.zh: 凡劳苦担重担的人，可以到我这里来，我就使你们得安息。

verse.en: But those who hope in the Lord will renew their strength. They will soar on wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not be faint.
verse.zh: 但那等候耶和华的，必从新得力。他们必如鹰展翅上腾，他们奔跑却不困倦，行走却不疲乏。

verse.en: For I know the plans I have for you, declares the Lord, plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future.
verse.zh: 耶和华说：我知道我向你们所怀的意念，是赐平安的意念，不是降灾祸的意念，要叫你们末后有指望。

verse.en: Love is patient, love is kind. It does not envy, it does not boast, it is not proud.
verse.zh: 爱是恒久忍耐，又有恩慈；爱是不嫉妒，爱是不自夸，不张狂。

verse.en: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.zh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

verse.en: And surely I am with you always, to the very end of the age.
verse.zh: 我就常与你们同在，直到世界的末了。

verse.en: Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind.
verse.zh: 不要效法这个世界，只要心意更新而变化。
